name: Alaska
status_why: The Division's own static files; its host leaves out its issuer certificate, which the kit's issuer repair handles (the chain must still end at a trusted root). The 26genr page is posted with no files yet.
system: Alaska Division of Elections' own results pages (www.elections.alaska.gov/election-results/e/?id=<code>) with static files in /results/<CODE>/, made with its tabulation system's exports (GA_ENR CSV, ElectionSummaryReport PDF)

results_page.label: Alaska Division of Elections: election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: Page posted; poll it until it links the precinct CSV (GA_ENR or ENRbyPrecinct).

feeds.address: https://www.elections.alaska.gov/results/<YY><GENR|PRIM>/ENRbyPrecinct.csv (2024 general) or GA_ENR_Precinct_State_of_Alaska.csv (2026 primary); summary https://www.elections.alaska.gov/results/<CODE>/ElectionSummaryReport.pdf; per house district HD<n>.pdf; RCV tabulations RCV-USRep.pdf, RCV-HD<n>.pdf; cast vote record zip
feeds.updates: election night as precincts report; then on the Division's published count days; ranked-choice tabulation runs about 15 days after (Nov 18)
feeds.note: 2026-10-09: ?id=26genr and ?id=24genr answered 200 only through the kit's states/net.get issuer repair (a plain Python request fails: 'unable to get local issuer certificate'). 26genr exists but links no files yet. The page states 'Results Status' when official.

races_in_feed: Senate, the at-large House seat, Governor, legislature, judicial retention, measures; borough and city elections are run by each clerk
local: Boroughs and cities run their own local elections, most not on Nov 3 (Anchorage in April, Fairbanks North Star Oct 6); Mat-Su and Kenai Peninsula post November contests as PDFs or pages
how_counted: Alaska counts on election night and adds absentee and questioned ballots on later count days. Ranked-choice rounds are counted about two weeks after the election.
count_order: District rows 'NN - Absentee', 'NN - Early Voting' and 'NN - Question' arrive on later count days; the night's figures are mostly ballots cast in person.
vote_types: Yes: each house district has 'NN - Absentee', 'NN - Early Voting' and 'NN - Question' rows beside its precincts (2026 primary file: 62 such rows in district 37). Useful for count order: absentee and question ballots are added on later count days.

rules.applies: every state and federal office on the general ballot
rules.note: First choices on the night; the Division tabulates the rounds about Nov 18 (scout).

ranked_choice: First choices on the night; rounds about two weeks later (scout: about Nov 18).

certify.body: the Alaska Division of Elections, after the state ballot counting review
certify.rule: Upon completion of the state ballot counting review (Alaska Stat. 15.15.450).
certify.local_rule: Local counts close no later than the day after the election (Alaska Stat. 15.15.370).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
